meta.description:
If something deforms your body beyond recognition and takes away your mind, will it still be you?... 
 
 A fast-paced mod with a variety of enemies, bosses and strange gameplay decisions! Right now there are 4 sectors out of 12! also There are still some unfinished things in here. 
 Code - SpaceTwoo. 
 Maps - SpaceTwoo SKYPETR, Lewiafan ROVO. 
 Sprites - SpaceTwoo, ArtmX, Bloody-Ocean 
 Other - Closed_Ink, Gribdius.
